segments.text: Your WhatsApp activity is leaking more than you think. This tool, device activity tracker, shows how delivery receipts plus RTT timing can reveal
exactly when someone's phone is active, idle, or offline without ever touching their device. Based on the careless whisper research paper, it measures
roundtrip times of message delivery receipts to detect when a device is being used in real time, when it's in standby, possible location or network
